def normalize_shape(cells):
    """A cell set as a canonical tuple-of-tuples 0/1 bounding-box mask with its top-left offset."""
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    H = max(r for r, c in cells) - r0 + 1; W = max(c for r, c in cells) - c0 + 1
    s = {(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in cells}
    return (r0, c0), tuple(tuple(1 if (r, c) in s else 0 for c in range(W)) for r in range(H))

def is_corner_bar_shape(shape, min_arm=4):
    """True if the shape is exactly two full adjacent edges of its bounding box (an L with arms >= min_arm)."""
    H, W = len(shape), len(shape[0])
    if H < min_arm or W < min_arm:
        return False
    cells = {(r, c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if shape[r][c]}
    for er in (0, H - 1):
